review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped for uses of ExchangePattern and ofRelation across the ErdosGinzburgZiv directory: they appear in four other files, so the structure is used. The structure holds two ℕ-valued functions, one for positive and one for negative multiplicities. Position is a tagged sigma-type of Fin, and Sample is an abbreviation for a dependent function type. I found no Mathlib structure that is the same concept with the same assumptions. The nearest candidates are Finsupp/Multiset encodings and SignType/Int.sign. They represent different things: the file needs a finite type of labelled positions with a ±1 sign, and the sign function has a fixed orientation. The sum lemmas and ofRelation are specific to this setting and are not generic copies. I did not search every Mathlib file exhaustively, so a small uncertainty remains. The practical case for consolidating anything is unclear, so I abstain.
